description: Take people off the app by the email they were invited with: one (`email`) or several (`emails`, up to 50). Within a minute or two they are refused on every address the app has, and an invitation they have not opened yet no longer lets them in; a link made without a name before then (`open_app` answering `named: false`) stops working too, so make a new one. Confirm with the person who they mean first, using the addresses from `people`. An address that is not on the list comes back in `failed` with the addresses that are, and the last owner cannot be removed. Without this tool, `npx uarpie people remove a@example.com` does the same.

emails.description: Several people at once, up to 50.

grant_ids.description: Instead of an email: a `grant_id` from `people` (a device has no email), or the one a removal gave back when the edge had not been told yet.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: remove_people
title: Take someone off the app
